name: hou_mcp_architectural_debug
description: Tier 10.5 — Full architectural features debug report. Accepts shell_json, runs the complete plan-build + review pipeline, and logs a comprehensive formatted report to the Vibrante-Node log panel. Includes counts and per-feature status for door openings, window openings, fireplace, beams, and wall shelves. No bridge calls — dry-run only. Use hou_mcp_architecture_realize to create actual geometry.
python_code:
import json
from src.nodes.base import BaseNode
from src.runtime.architectural_features import (
    get_architectural_plan_builder,
    get_environment_architecture_review,
    get_architectural_feature_realizer,
    ARCHITECTURE_STATUS_FAIL,
)

class Hou_Mcp_Architectural_Debug(BaseNode):
    name = "hou_mcp_architectural_debug"

    def __init__(self):
        super().__init__()
        # [AUTO-GENERATED-PORTS-START]
        self.add_input("shell_json", "string", widget_type="text", default="{}")
        self.add_output("plan_json")
        self.add_output("review_json")
        self.add_output("architecture_status")
        self.add_output("architecture_report")
        self.add_output("production_ready", "bool")
        # [AUTO-GENERATED-PORTS-END]

    async def execute(self, inputs):
        raw_shell = (inputs.get("shell_json") or "{}").strip()
        try:
            shell_dict = json.loads(raw_shell)
            if not isinstance(shell_dict, dict):
                shell_dict = {}
        except Exception:
            shell_dict = {}

        try:
            plan    = get_architectural_plan_builder().build(shell_dict)
            review  = get_environment_architecture_review().review(plan, shell_dict)
            op_dicts = get_architectural_feature_realizer().build_op_dicts(plan)

            env = plan.environment or "unknown"
            sep = "-" * 62
            lines = [
                "",
                f"ARCHITECTURAL FEATURES DEBUG: {env.upper()}",
                sep,
                f"  Room: {plan.room_width:.1f}m x {plan.room_height:.1f}m x {plan.room_length:.1f}m",
                f"  Outdoor: {plan.is_outdoor}",
                sep,
                f"  DOOR OPENINGS    ({len(plan.door_openings)})",
            ]
            for o in plan.door_openings:
                lines.append(f"    [{o.opening_id}]  face={o.wall_face}  "
                              f"{o.width:.2f}m x {o.height:.2f}m  "
                              f"node={o.houdini_node_name}  "
                              f"ok={'Y' if o.validated else 'N'}")

            lines.append(f"  WINDOW OPENINGS  ({len(plan.window_openings)})")
            for o in plan.window_openings:
                lines.append(f"    [{o.opening_id}]  face={o.wall_face}  "
                              f"{o.width:.2f}m x {o.height:.2f}m  "
                              f"node={o.houdini_node_name}  "
                              f"ok={'Y' if o.validated else 'N'}")

            lines.append(f"  FIREPLACES       ({len(plan.fireplace_placements)})")
            for fp in plan.fireplace_placements:
                lines.append(f"    [{fp.feature_id}]  face={fp.wall_face}  "
                              f"back_dist={fp.back_face_distance:.3f}m  "
                              f"ok={'Y' if fp.validated else 'N'}")

            lines.append(f"  BEAMS            ({len(plan.beam_placements)})")
            for b in plan.beam_placements:
                lines.append(f"    [{b.feature_id}]  axis={b.long_axis}  "
                              f"len={b.length:.2f}m  gap={b.gap_to_ceiling:.3f}m  "
                              f"intersects_wall={b.intersects_wall}  "
                              f"ok={'Y' if b.validated else 'N'}")

            lines.append(f"  WALL SHELVES     ({len(plan.shelf_placements)})")
            for s in plan.shelf_placements:
                lines.append(f"    [{s.feature_id}]  face={s.wall_face}  "
                              f"h={s.ty:.2f}m  floating={s.is_floating}")

            lines += [
                sep,
                f"  GEOMETRY OPS     ({len(op_dicts)} total)",
                f"    Houdini nodes that will be created:",
            ]
            for op in op_dicts:
                lines.append(f"    /obj/{op['houdini_node_name']}  [{op['feature_type']}]")

            lines += [
                sep,
                f"  ARCHITECTURE REVIEW",
                f"    Score:  {review.architecture_score:.3f}",
                f"    Status: {review.status}",
                f"    Ready:  {'YES' if review.production_ready else 'NO'}",
                sep,
            ]

            report = "\n".join(lines)
            self.log_info(report)

            return {
                "plan_json":           json.dumps(plan.to_dict(), sort_keys=True, indent=2),
                "review_json":         json.dumps(review.to_dict(), sort_keys=True, indent=2),
                "architecture_status": review.status,
                "architecture_report": review.architecture_report,
                "production_ready":    review.production_ready,
                "exec_out":            True,
            }
        except Exception as exc:
            self.log_error(f"hou_mcp_architectural_debug failed: {exc}")
            return {
                "plan_json": "{}", "review_json": "{}",
                "architecture_status": ARCHITECTURE_STATUS_FAIL,
                "architecture_report": f"ERROR: {exc}",
                "production_ready": False, "exec_out": True,
            }

def register_node():
    return Hou_Mcp_Architectural_Debug
